ratings.comment:
Green is a great teacher and I'm very happy with choosing this class, you learn a lot of important things for life.
Getting an A is not a hard task as long as you listen in class, make hw, and study a bit.

Professor Green was awesome! Great professor, explained things so well and actually made it interesting. Midterms were easy, only thing that was annoying was the fact that it started at 7:45 am. Only reason I ended up with an AB was because I skipped lecture too often, so ATTEND LECTURES!!
Very knowledgeable on the best strategies for learning and he incorporates that into the structure of the class. The course structure is perfect, but he doesn't connect with students very well.

Professor sets you up for success. 5 exams (1 drop) and lots of busy work homework but by doing the homework it makes you a wizard at the content. I finished with like a 98, as long as you somewhat apply yourself you'll get an A.
Green is a great professor; take this class if you can.

He's a really easy-going professor and clearly wants everyone in the room to succeed in class. It's basically impossible to fail the class even if you try to and the way he formats exams are almost identical to the practice material he posts online, making it really easy to study for upcoming exams. There's no midterm or cumulative final either.
He makes taking the test so easy. Plus no final but all cumulative tests

The best prof I have ever had. Showed up, take notes, and do the practice quiz from your heart, and you will pass the class with an A+. Attendance is just a formality, but make sure you are there. Every lecture matters.  Just make sure you don't rush the post-quiz in the last hour. Those usually take about an hour.
Show up and get an A, with that said, attendance is highly mandatory, can only miss two classes.

Professor Green is phenomenal. He is very knowledgeable and passionate about psychology and it comes through in his lectures. The structure of his class makes it easy to master the material and get a good grade. There are great extra credit opportunities, enough to bring you up a whole letter grade. If you want to take psych 202, try and get Green.

Heard he's the best psych 202 teacher, much easier than some of the other professors. I LOVED this class- he really wanted students to do well & set up the class so it was easy to do so. Got an A without really studying and there's minimal homework, plus tons of options for extra credit. I learned a ton too! I love you prof green

Professor Green is an incredible professor. His lectures are extremely concise and prepare you well for the exams. Homework is essentially practice exam questions and the exams themselves are quite simple if you studied. Extra credit is low-effort and has a big impact on your grade if you do it. 100% worth taking his class!
If you are taking psych 202 at madison TAKE IT WITH PROFESSOR GREEN!! Best decision of my year!

Prof. Green has unique teaching style. Before each lecture, you are expected to complete a Pre-Module Quiz, for which you only need to put in a "Good faith effort" to be given the point. Additionally, each lecture has a Psych In The News section relating the topic to a real-life instance and a Post-Module Quiz, with unlimited attempts.
I loved C. Shawn GREEN he gave great materials to help you with your exams.

If you're between psych 202 professors, take Green. He takes attendance and makes you sit with the same groups to do group assignments, but the exams are all multiple choice and they are almost the same as practice exams. Easiest A you can earn if you go to lecture. He also offers tons of extra credit opportunities!

Absolutely worth the 8am!! Really got me interested in psychology. Professor Green's research career is dedicated to figuring out how people learn best, so this guy has got it figured out. I found the class easy, and was shocked at how much I actually learned!
Dr. Green is a great professor. Totally worth waking up at 8am. However attendance is mandatory
Easy take this class

This was probably one of the most organized classes on campus! There are weekly quizzes that have the same exact questions as the test, so you are always prepared for the exams. Really loved that he posted the lecture slides prior to the class, and recorded lectures as well. Appreciated his care for psychology and his students.

Dr. Green is the must-take professor for Psych 202. His lectures are condensed into relevant course material and his assessments grade only content discussed in lecture. He provides classes with more than enough study material as the whole course is based on reviewing, so if you put in the effort you will almost certainly get an A and learn a lot.

C Shawn Greene is great. Super helpful lectures and awesome grading scale. You have 5 exams and get to drop one. No final exam. He is a little stage shy but his lectures are good enough to make up for it. Definitely recommend taking him even if it means an 8am. Great professor!

Green is an amazing professor and great at teaching. 2 weekly online-quizzes with UNLIMITED retakes (need to get a 14/15 to receive point for quiz) AND he uses alot of the exact questions on his quizzes on the midterm. Midterm exam is very easy and he puts practice exams online from previous year's midterms to practice with. Easy A.
Professor Green is so nice. The class is not difficult but I assure you that you can learn a lot.

If you need a psych credit, without a doubt take this class! It's early but it's worth it if you want quality. Green's class is one of the few classes you will actually learn and retain information to use in real life. The grading is very fair so if you do all the work and extra credit you should end up with an A. One of the best professors!

Highly recommend Professor Green for psych 202! As long as you attend lectures and do the required work this class will be a breeze! I also feel like I learned a lot without having to memorize a ton of information. Getting up at 8am for his lectures was 100% worth it.

Prof Green is amazing; he is always willing to help and ensures that his students succeed. His readings can get a bit long, but they're full of information that is on all the quizzes and exams. He is a fair grader and allows for growth. He also offers 15 points of extra credit throughout the semester. Overall great prof and super nice

Prof Green was an amazing professor who cares about what he's teaching and his students. He is very knowledgeable and his class materials and lectures are easy to follow. He never assigns busy work and the grading system is very fair. I would 100% recommend him it is worth waking up for the 8am.

Very good professor. Had him during covid fall 2020 totally online, two lectures a week, content wasn't difficult and was a pretty easy A. He's a fair professor, basically the whole class is reading the material and doing pre and post class quizzes (which are very easy). Highly reccomend this guy's class, he's very kind.

Favorite professor. Online class was a bit boring and was tough because it was at 8 AM, but his written out textbook makes the information very easy to learn. How his class is set up makes it feel like he truly cares about your learning and not just passing the class. Very good overall.

Professor Green was a great professor that truly cared about student learning. His study that he is doing for research is based around student learning so everything you do has purpose and there is no busy work. His only lecture is at 8 am, but on zoom it is not hard to wake up for the class. Overall a really good professor and I really recommend.

Prof Green was my favorite prof this entire semester, his class was both interesting in material and in the way he formatted the class. The information isn't hard, mostly memorization, and he provides a ton of practice quizzes and questions that are similar to exam questions. There's also a lot of easy extra credit opportunities.
Amazing class and professor; the way he teaches is great! Anyone will be able to do well in this class, as long as they try their best.

One of the better teachers I've had so far. Great lectures, really implements learning strategies into the homework, and it definitely works. Made psychology interesting enough that I considered switching majors for a bit.

Wake up for this mans 8am. Just do it. And I promise you, you will get an A. Green makes the class interesting and engaging, and the content isn't too difficult. The pre lecture and post lecture quizzes really help you understand the material, with exams using almost identical questions. He allows for extra credit too, which is always a plus.

Dr. Green is the only reason that I push myself to wake up for the 8 AM lectures. His lectures are intriguing yet he makes the material simple. The extra credit is very generous so take advantage of that. As long as you don't skip lectures and do the post-class quizzes you should be able to get the A.

Professor Green knows a lot about educational psychology, and he implements a lot of practices that are INCREDIBLY conducive to learning. You have short, inconsequential quizzes before and after every lecture, and these help you to learn the material. I barely had to study for the final, which was in class. Super nice not to have to worry about.

Green is the GOAT! He makes it impossible for students not to get an A. The test questions are pulled directly from the homework that you have to do, which is not hard if you pay attention in lecture. The extra credit will raise you a whole letter grade. Only downside is that attendance is mandatory, but you will still definitely get an A
Professor Green was by far one of the best teachers Ive ever had. Super engaging, very helpful if you ask questions, fun lectures.

Green teaches differently than the other psych professors. We had pre & post class homework but no textbook. It worked because our class averages on tests were around 42/45 and I felt confident about the material. There are also plenty of extra credit options. Lectures can get long but if you show up to class (mandatory) it is hard to not get an A.

Prof. Green is one of the best professors at UW-Madison. His class is easy because of how he includes elements from what we learn in class into the class itself. His tests were fair and easy even if you did the bare minimum amount of homework. Overall, an easy A.

Prof Green is one of the best professors at UW. Psych202 is very easy if you have him - the exams are exactly the same as practice. Prof Green teaches so you remember things for the exams and barely have to study b/c you already are prepared! I know 8am lectures can be rough, but totally worth it in order to get an A in this class. 10/10 recommend
He is awesome!!! I learned a lot from this class!
Professor Green is a great lecturer & you really learn a lot from him. His tests are very fair & if you show up to lecture and stay on top of the material, the class is an easy A.

Best psych class out there! No textbook, and out of class work includes a few short assignments a week, plus pre and post lecture quizzes. The lecture quiz questions are super similar in style to the questions on the exams, which are very fair and straightforward. I had no exposure to psych ever, and the class is ending up being an easy A for me.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Super knowledgeable about psychology and makes sure you are ready to pass an exam. If you just do the assigned work and practice quizzes it's nearly impossible to fail

Super engaging and interesting lectures, he loves what he does and that is very obvious. He keeps you on your toes, and you have assigned seating groups but can sit anywhere with that group. Exams are fair, if you listen in lecture you will do fine, plus you can get a ton of extra credit from participating in research studies.

Professor Green was great. He incorporates specific Psych material into his own lectures-- where you sit, how you learn the material, etc. The exams are simple extensions of his practice exams, which are quite useful. Combine his laid-back approach with interesting lectures and extra credit, and you've got a strong Psych class.
Super easy. 80% of the class gets an A with Chris. Take him for Psy 202 if you can. I never studied for any test and aced them all.
Runs a very easy psych 202 class, most other classes have tons of reading and studying, but Greene focuses on important points and keeps the class very minimalist.

This was one of my favorite classes at UW-Madison so far! Professor Green has no textbook, and only assigns readings from links he posts to articles that are applicable to life. His tests are very straight forward and I did well on every one. This class made me fall in love with psychology

Professor Green is a great teacher. He makes sure you actually learn the concepts and don't just learn it all for the test and then forget it. If you do the easy weekly quizzes and homework, you will not have a problem on the tests. Highly reccommend this class.

Professor Green is a genuine professor. He truly seems to care about all his students and if you have any questions he seems happy to help. Would recommend showing up to class and reviewing old exams that he posts during the semester and it'll be an easy A.

Take him for Psych 202 if you can. Learned a ton but it was the easiest class i've taken in Madison so far. Very clear on what he wants you to know and he actually uses psychology to teach you so you actually learn. Readings are online and completely optional. No textbook, won't make you buy any extra stuff.
Best Psych 202 Professor. Makes material very clear and tests are fairly easy if you put in some effort.

Great professor. His lectures can get a bit boring, but the materials presented are always intriguing. He's very understanding of his students and he teaches good study habits by proving it with psychological research. He's probably the reason why I changed my major into Psychology.

Its hard not to learn the material given how much practice you get.  There are 6 graded assignments every week (4 quizzes, 2 writing).  Plus the exams are all cumulative.  So by the time you take the last exam, you've gone over the material a ton of times whether you've "studied" or not. Readings for every class, but no textbook - all online.

I took Psy202 with him last semester. It was an easy A. A lot of extra credits chances. Exams are easy as long as you go through his power point carefully. Lecture videos are posted online, but attendance is recorded and counts towards the final grades. No textbook required.

Most straight-forward class I've taken here. The class is laid out incredibly well and you never are left guessing what expectations are or what's going on in the class. Green offers his class videos and powerpoints on Learn@UW which are very useful when studying. You see the exact same format of questions throughout the semester which are on exams

Great professor. Must attend lecture to pass. Posts all lectures online. No textbook and all the homework is pre and post lecture quizzes online and writing prompts and multiple choice questions every sunday night. Very easy class to get an A in and would definitely take this course again. Lectures are long but interesting and very informative.

Amazing Professor. EASY online homework/ 10 question quizzes every few days but "textbook" is chapters online (free). The way he structures his classes and semester makes the class extremely easy, especially if you have taken any psych classes prior. Four exams but no 2 hour final. Extra Credit available. Takes attendance in Lectures- don't skip.

Greatest class I've taken first semester of freshmen year! Best psych teacher.  Knew exactly what was going to be on the test.  Yes, the class does get long, but he does group interaction in the middle of class. You get points just by showing up to class!
Best teacher ever. If you have to take psych 202, take it with this guy. You will not regret it. He is amazing
Easiest Psych in Madison by far, plus no textbook in his class which saves you $$$

C. Shawn Green structures the class by how well you will learn from a Psychological standpoint... I always know what will be on a test and how it will be structured.  Also, he doesn't make you buy a textbook... just gives you interesting articles to read about class topics. Do the homework and study and you'll get an A on exams.
Definitely a fun class. Low effort as long as you've studied psych before.

We were not required to purchase a textbook at all for his class. Professor Green does not teach the normal Psych topics. He skips learning neurons which is cool. You have to take pre and post lecture quizzes which are only worth one point. His class is fun and it was easy to learn.
Definitely one of my favorite classes.  Makes information easy to understand and relatable. Exams are easy questions seen previously from online homework
Professor Green is a great lecturer and goes out of his way to design his class around the principles of learning.
Interesting professor, gets the material across and is funny on occasion. There are very few grades in the class, so don't slack on the exams. Lots of reading and memorization.
The curve in this class is ridiculous.  The tests are incredibly hard.  I would avoid taking this class unless you have to.

He moves pretty quickly in lecture, but is very thorough in covering the material. Grade is based on 4 multiple choice midterms and you can drop 1 of the first 3. About 2 readings from the book a week. Very willing to help. Excellent TA as well.

Prof. Green does not have you at the edge of your seat during lectures, but is clear and his knowledge is apparent. His tests are simple as long as you pay attention. I was really dreading psych, but he made it tolerable for a non-psych major.
